free_tier_limits.correction: Developer Sandbox: up to 10 devices and 30 days of data storage; additional Sandbox resource and payload limits apply.

rate_limits.correction: Losant publishes endpoint-specific throttles and limits rather than one global limit; for example, Device Send State is limited to 30 calls per 15 seconds per device.

description.correction: Losant is an industrial IoT application platform exposing a REST API for managing applications, devices, workflows, data tables, experiences, and related resources. Developers use API access tokens with documented resource endpoints; the API URLs are not globally version-prefixed.

notes: Losant remains active after its 2026 SUSE acquisition, and its official status page reports the API operational. The entry invents an unpublished-rate-limits claim and overlooks published Sandbox limits. Official REST documentation only describes Bearer-header authentication, not a token query parameter.
